title: Open-closed localization for relative etale compact support
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Work in the bounded-below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For any separated finite-type morphism $h:T\to B$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a compactification $c=(j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T,p:\overline T\to B)$ consists of a quasi-compact open immersion $j$ and a proper morphism $p$ with $h=pj$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]; write $Rh_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be such a morphism, let $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and put $g=fj_U$, $h=fi$. For every $K\in D^+(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_h$ there is a distinguished triangle $Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K\to Rf_!^{c_f}K\to Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K\to (Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)[1]$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] fit in the exact sequence $\cdots\to\mathcal H^q(Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)\to\mathcal H^q(Rf_!^{c_f}K)\to\mathcal H^q(Rh_!^{c_h}i^{-1}K)\to\mathcal H^{q+1}(Rg_!^{c_g}j_U^{-1}K)\to\cdots$.
